Iacob returned at euen from the field, Lia went out to
meete him, and ſaid: Companie with me, becauſe with
ſteries therin. Wages I haue hired thee for my ſonnes mandragores. And
Ii. 22 c. 56. he ſlept with her that night. † And God heard her prayers : 17
cont. Fauſtum: and she conceaued and bare the fifth ſonne, † and ſaid : God
hath geuen me a reward, becauſe I gaue my handmaid to
my huſband. And she called his name Iſſachar. † Againe 19
Lia conceauing, bare the ſixt ſonne, † and ſaid : God hath 20
endowed me with a good dowrie : this turne alſo my huſ-
band wil be with me, for becauſe I haue borne him ſix
ſonnes, and therfore ſhe called his name, Labulon. † After 21
whom ſhe bare a daughter, named Dina. † Our Lord alſo 22
remembring Rachel, heard her, and opened her wombe.
